notebook_id.description: The notebook short_id (the public id in the URL, e.g. `aBcD1234`).

variables.description: The complete list of variables the notebook should have, in display order. This replaces the current list, so include every variable you want to keep. At most 10. Pass an empty list to remove them all.

name.description: Identifier cells read: `{name}` in a SQL cell, a plain global in a Python cell. Letters, numbers, and underscores; must not start with a number, repeat another variable, or reuse a cell's dataframe_name.

type.description: How the value binds: 'string', 'number', 'boolean', or 'date'. A 'date' is an absolute ISO 8601 date or datetime ('2025-01-31', '2025-01-31T09:00:00Z'); relative expressions like '-7d' are rejected, so compute the date first.

value.description: The current value. Omit or pass null for a declared-but-unset variable.
